title: Research status and verification
caution: AI-generated research · independent verification pending. The results, proofs, code and data have not yet been independently verified by human experts or formalized in Lean. Use them with caution; exact checks establish only their stated computational scope.
summary: The targeted study records 36 decisions among 38 cases: 29 exclusions and seven unitary constructions. Two general categorification questions remain open: R6_4_155 and R6_8_1660. Rank eight is complete through multiplicity two. A feasible set of necessary conditions is not a categorical construction.
coverage_notes: Ranks two, three and four are classified without a multiplicity restriction. Exactly fifteen rank-four Grothendieck rings occur, and every rank-four categorification admits a spherical structure. The table records the separate finite censuses.

The bound is the largest multiplicity included in the displayed census, not necessarily a complete classification range. Rank six is complete through multiplicity three; its exact bands 5, 6, 7 and 9 are also complete, while bands 4 and 8 each contain one open case.
Rank eight is complete through multiplicity two: 48 Grothendieck rings at exact multiplicity one and 29 at exact multiplicity two. The latter band contains 848 exclusions and 29 unitary models.

Rank-six models comprise 56 unitary constructions and one spherical construction that is not pseudo-unitary. Completeness means coverage of the stated census by the project's recorded arguments; it does not assert independent human or formal verification.

open_cases.heading: Odd cyclic Clifford constraints
paragraphs: Every odd generalized pivotal rotation must factor through a cyclic spin character. All 1,144 tested blocks pass. The all-order path-Clifford divisibility condition for the source family holds exactly at even parameter values, including the parameter four of this case.
The unique rank-26 modular candidate and rank-22 based-module witness remain necessary data. No compatible associators, coherent module category or general obstruction is established.

open_cases.heading: Complete indicators and central phase masses
paragraphs: In the positive spherical representative, saturated modular representations determine all indicator sequences and every central phase mass. The eight spin objects form four dual pairs, all with restriction 2X+2gX+sigma+3T.

Exact phase Gram constraints leave 640 labelled restriction-data profiles in three branches of 68, 286 and 286. These profiles are neither categories nor complete modular fusion data. They do not construct compatible associators or exclude all categorifications.

replay_sections.heading: Ranks four and five
paragraphs: The unrestricted rank-four proof gives FPdim < 1000 and multiplicity at most 31 without assuming pivotality. Its exact finite classification checks 1,692 rings, 1,677 exclusions and 15 models. Every rank-four complex fusion category admits a spherical structure; the sharp bounds are FPdim ≤ 24+12√3 and multiplicity ≤ 6. The theoretical arguments and exact computations have distinct verification obligations.
Both complete rank-four replays passed: 889,530 rings, 15 models and 889,515 exclusions. Each regenerated 6,470,006 signed orbits; an independent full unsigned recount also passed.

The reconstructed rank-five package passed all 40,999 pinned classes, 17 model matches and 40,982 general exclusions in normal and optimized Python. The two reconstructed ledgers agree byte-for-byte. The unavailable source ledger was not recovered; the reconstructed ledger has its own recorded digest.

replay_sections.heading: Ranks seven and eight
paragraphs: The complete base-certificate loops passed in normal Python. Separate source-bound transition replays and current-ledger checks passed in normal and optimized Python with exact parent restoration. These checks account for the current partitions displayed in this note.

The rank-eight base replay checks all 973 records, including 75 signed proof trees, four rank-seven subring proof transfers and six appendix tensor transfers. The R8_2_24 rigidity package separately checks its canonical tensor, neutral fusion rules and finite associator-weight claims; the categorical proof has separate AI audits.

replay_sections.heading: Rank-six necessary conditions
paragraphs: The odd cyclic Clifford checker passes all 1,144 tested blocks and its invalid-input controls. Independent exact indicator and phase-mass checks cover both conjugate choices for the second residual; the complete profile allocation leaves 640 labelled possibilities. Normal and optimized replays pass within this necessary-condition scope.

replay_sections.heading: Rank six: a combined verification campaign
paragraphs: The complete initial process checked all 25,362 exclusion certificates: 25,355 passed and seven failed. Each of those seven then passed the complete unchanged checker under SymPy's Python backend. Exact matrix comparison attributes the failures to equation ordering or orientation and positional separating-vector conventions; no proof inequality or certificate was relaxed.

Both post-loop checks skipped by the initial failure gate passed separately. The model registry gives 57 matches, and the multiplicity-one partition gives 39 = 18 + 21. A hash-bound aggregate validates complete certificate coverage and 299 source/input bindings.

This is a combined campaign, not a successful single full run or an all-Python full-census pass. The initial process exited with failure, and that status is preserved in the evidence. Its loaded backend/version was not measured at startup; the global python-flint installation changed from 0.8.0 to 0.9.0 during the run, so worker and child processes may have loaded different versions.
The complete-replay orchestrator has passed identity and rejection-control checks but has not itself been executed end to end. Its existence must not be reported as an additional full-census success.

replay_note: Add --historical to run the complete source-bound certificate chain on isolated inputs. Checkers using assert require normal Python; an optimized invocation alone removes those assertions. The current-publication verifier also checks the identity and consistency of the published documents and their website copies.

interpretation.meaning: A checksum binds a statement or calculation to specified bytes. It cannot establish that their mathematics is correct.
A program verifies its implemented finite equations, enumerations or tensor comparisons. Its mathematical assumptions remain part of the proof obligation.

A claimed construction or obstruction must establish the hypotheses connecting the finite calculation to a fusion category. Source and arithmetic checks support a categorical proof only within their stated scope.
Separate AI review passes are not independent human verification. No human verification or Lean formalization is claimed here.

theoretical_results.heading: Rank eight: an inner-square obstruction
paragraphs: For R8_2_24, a hypothetical complex categorification has a pseudo-unitary Galois conjugate with a rank-four neutral component. Saturated modular compression forces its second indicators. Conjugation by an odd invertible would fix every neutral simple label and square to conjugation by the neutral involution.

A simultaneous pivotal chart and the short weights of associator coefficients show that such a square root would yield infinitely many inequivalent tensor functors between fixed fusion categories. Tensor-functor rigidity excludes this, giving a general complex obstruction. The source and finite-weight checks support the argument within their stated scope; its categorical reasoning remains subject to independent mathematical verification.
